title: Periodontal Infectogenomics in Africa: The Biological Case for a Population-Centred Research Agenda.
html: African populations harbour the greatest human genetic diversity on earth and carry the highest global burden of severe periodontitis, yet their absence from periodontal infectogenomics represents a biological limitation of the field with profound implications for host-microbe interaction research. This Perspective builds the biological case for African populations as an urgent research priority and proposes a research roadmap integrating genomics, metagenomics and multiomics approaches.
